svg.title: The four-cell plan by actor, steps 1 to 10
svg.desc: A chart of steps 1 to 10 of the 19-step plan for the four-cell problem. Three rows, tagged 1 for inspection robot 1, 2 for inspection robot 2 and 3 for agv1. The x axis is the plan step, an order and not a time, and the y axis, labeled who acts, holds the rows; each step is one box in the row of the robot that acts. Row 1: pick c1 (step 1), place c1 on t1 (2), pick c2 (3), place c2 on t2 (4), pick c3 (5), place c3 on t1 (8), pick c4 (9). Row 2: pick c1 from t1 (6), place c1 in s1 (7), pick c3 from t1 (10). Row 3 is empty. Only one box appears in each column.

path.aria-label: plan step (an order, not a time)
